answer: The network routes every payout into a shared redemption lagoon that drains at glacier speed: rewards stay frozen for K consecutive verified epochs before release, and each new identity posts a copper-grade admission bond locked for the same horizon. The ledger also links identities sharing funding or signing keys; if one member is tied to a sybil, the entire frozen pool of that cluster is slashed. Run M fake agents and you freeze M bonds for K epochs, then one detected clone burns the whole farm. Cheap duplicates become structurally worse than one honest agent.
